idea.title: Airspace Stack
idea.hook: Drag planes to the runway; when two routes turn red, tap one plane onto another altitude.
idea.prototype: A core-only deterministic air-traffic trajectory puzzle with drag routing, runway capture, three altitude layers, projected conflicts, automatic wave progression, collision/retry, and a gated learn-by-doing tutorial.
idea.why_model_fit: The game depends on explicit state, geometry, predictive simulation, deterministic time stepping, and directly testable browser interactions.
idea.lose_condition: Two aircraft breach separation on the same altitude

ten_min_loop: Route increasingly dense arrival waves, read red trajectory conflicts, and separate planes across three altitude layers without introducing additional management systems.
